# AIEO Checker
> An open technical auditing tool by SkyDevLab for evaluating AI Engine Optimization and AI Search Readiness.

## Overview
AIEO Checker provides deterministic evaluation of websites across five key pillars:
1. AI Crawlability (Robots.txt, HTTPS, Canonical tags, XML sitemaps)
2. Content Structure (Semantic HTML5 landmarks, Heading hierarchy, Text-to-HTML ratio)
3. Structured Data (Schema.org JSON-LD graph parsing, sameAs verification)
4. Entity Clarity (Cross-source entity disambiguation and consistency)
5. Answer Readiness (Deterministic heuristic coverage of core conversational queries)
